Amendment No. 1 sets the Quarrendon Freight Lines seat count at 185 seats, effective 2025-09-01 (signed 2025-08-19).

Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) raises it to 230 seats, effective 2027-01-01. If the deck should show what is in force today, use 185. I've posted both figures in this DM.
